best_for: Network admins and security learners who need to find hosts and open ports on a network they are allowed to scan.

points.title: Finds what is on the network
points.text: Nmap scans hosts and ports to show which machines are up, and which services they expose. It is free, under a modified GNU GPLv2 license.

points.title: This listing is far behind
points.text: The winget package here is at 7.80 and keeps 2 versions. nmap.org offers 7.993 as its current Windows installer, so get recent fixes from the project's own download page.

points.title: Zenmap comes in the box
points.text: The official Windows installer includes the Zenmap GUI, plus Ncat and Ndiff. It runs on Windows 7 and Server 2008 R2 and newer.

points.title: Npcap has its own license
points.text: On Windows, Nmap captures packets through Npcap. The free Npcap edition is limited to 5 systems, except when used with Nmap, Wireshark or Microsoft Defender for Identity, and silent installs need the paid OEM edition.

points.title: Mac and Linux get their own packages
points.text: No Mac or Linux build is listed here. nmap.org has an x86-64 DMG for Mac and RPMs plus source for Linux, and most distributions package it.
